integrity: Mathematical proof uses an explicit fixed-simplex lemma, signed Lefschetz traces, the published exact homotopy classification, and rational character theory. The archived reproducibility program and a complete k=2 acyclic Morse matching provide separate finite checks. No independent scientific audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The new finding is the complete rational translation representation of H_2 for all k>=2, not the nonequivariant homotopy classification. The latter is a 2025 published theorem. The rational representation is not an integral splitting; the full automorphism-group representation is not determined. Numerical checks k=2,3 do not prove the uniform assertion.
source_ids: G. Chaparro Sumalave, Vietoris-Rips Complexes of the Circle and the Torus (2016-10, day unverified)
title: Two coordinate-permutation modules in critical toroidal Vietoris–Rips homology
